findings.summary: Retry loop breaks because the live state filter inside the attempt loop incorrectly excludes comments in 'replied' state
findings.suggested_fix: Change the filter in the attempt loop to allow 'replied' state: c.state === 'pending' || c.state === 'replied'.

findings.summary: The batching execution branch is missing the ESCALATION_BUDGET fallback and rollback logic when all attempts fail
findings.suggested_fix: Add an attempt === ESCALATION_BUDGET check after batch execution to block unresolved comments and call rollbackFix, similar to the non-batch branch.

findings.summary: In the non-batch fallback branch, runningStartSha is not updated between comments, causing rollbackFix to erase prior successful fixes
findings.suggested_fix: Update runningStartSha after each successfully processed comment inside the loop, or prevent grouping comments if useBatching is false.

findings.summary: Missing test coverage for batch execution exhausting ESCALATION_BUDGET
findings.suggested_fix: Add a test case where a batch fails all attempts to verify it correctly blocks the comments and triggers rollbackFix.

findings.summary: Synchronous filesystem methods (writeFileSync, readFileSync) are used inside async port implementations
findings.suggested_fix: Replace writeFileSync and readFileSync with writeFile and readFile from fs/promises.
